name: Japan
standard: JIS X 8341-3:2016 (identical to ISO/IEC 40500:2012 = WCAG 2.0), target Level AA

laws.cite: Act for Eliminating Discrimination against Persons with Disabilities (障害者差別解消法)
laws.summary: Requires reasonable accommodation; public bodies and, since an amendment, private businesses must provide it.

policy_docs.title: Digital Agency — Web Accessibility Introduction Guidebook
MIC — みんなの公共サイト運用ガイドライン

applies_to: National and local public bodies (MIC guideline expects JIS X 8341-3 AA); private businesses via the reasonable-accommodation duty.

deadlines.what: Reasonable accommodation became mandatory for private businesses (amended Act) — not verified here
Digital Agency guidebook incorporated into the Digital Society Promotion Standard Guidelines (informative)

mobile: implied — the guidebook added a smartphone accessibility section (2024-03-29 revision); JIS X 8341-3 is web content.
procurement: The guidebook is aimed partly at procurement staff and contract language.
enforcement: Guidance-based for web; there is no web-specific penalty regime.
notes: The MIC guideline's AA expectation comes from search summaries. The Cabinet Office and MIC URLs were not opened. The April 2024 private-sector mandate is from general knowledge.
